resolution.question: Sanjay handed in his notice at Nimbus Freight this morning. Will his manager come back with a counteroffer within five working days?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that Sanjay's manager actually communicated a counteroffer to Sanjay before the end of five working days from the start time, i.e., by 2026-08-03T18:00:00+05:30. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
